before.content:
"gradlew", "gradle", "package.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "pnpm-workspace.yaml",
        "contracts", "protocol", "scripts", "deploy", "ji", "ji-java", "tooling", "docs/java-rewrite"
    )
    & tar -czf $archive --exclude='*/build' --exclude='*/node_modules' --exclude='*/dist' --exclude='.gold-band' -C $root @paths
    $remoteRoot = '$HOME/ji-stage5-gate'
    & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $key $target "mkdir -p $remoteRoot"
    & scp -q -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $key $archive "${target}:ji-stage5-gate/source.tar.gz"

after.content:
"gradlew", "gradle", "package.json", "pnpm-lock.yaml", "pnpm-workspace.yaml",
        "contracts", "protocol", "scripts", "deploy", "ji", "ji-java", "tooling", "docs/java-rewrite"
    )
    $tar = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot "System32\tar.exe"
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $tar -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Windows system tar is unavailable" }
    & $tar -czf $archive --exclude='*/build' --exclude='*/node_modules' --exclude='*/dist' --exclude='.gold-band' -C $root @paths
    $remoteRoot = '$HOME/ji-stage5-gate'
    & ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -i $key $target "mkdir -p $remoteRoot"
